messages:
alex: Heads-up: starting offsite packaging for private-vpc 1.4.0-rc2 now. tagging images, building sealed bundle. ETA ~30m. @maya @sasha

deploy-bot: build-job #4572 kicked: packer/airgap -> private-vpc-1.4.0-rc2 (step: image-build)

maya: Copy. Are we pinning kube-connector? 0.9.1 had that GC leak in last canary.

alex: Good catch — pinning kube-connector to 0.9.0 for this RC. We'll add note in installer manifest and release notes.

ben: If we pin, update the installer manifest and sign again. Also add a short migration note for customers that upgrade from 1.3.x.

alex: Agreed. I'll update manifests and push signed artifacts. Command I'm running:

```
/scripts/build-airgap.sh \
  --tag private-vpc-1.4.0-rc2 \
  --kube-connector=0.9.0 \
  --secrets ksm://redwood/packager/key-v2
```

sasha: For cutover: ops asked for a narrow change window. ops-ci, can we hold 23:00-01:00 UTC tonight?

ops-ci: Holding 23:00-01:00 UTC. I'll also set deploy-bot to require manual approval for canary > 2 customers.

deploy-bot: artifact sealed: private-vpc-1.4.0-rc2.tar.gz sha256=3f7a9c4b2d1e8f5c6a9b0d2c4e7f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8 size=412MB

maya: Can we codify rollback criteria here: canary error rate >5% sustained for 10m OR latency p50 >300ms for 15m -> auto-fallback to private-vpc-1.3.7 (pinned)?

alex: Yes. Plan: start canary on 2 mirror customers for 60m. If criteria met, deploy-bot will trigger fallback manifest switch to 1.3.7 and mark RC as aborted. Manual intervention required to repackage. I'll add to release notes and the ops runbook.

ben: Add an explicit step to rotate signing key if packaging fails signature validation. Link to key rotation checklist: https://internal.redwood.dev/ops/key-rotation (private)

alex: Updated release-notes draft snippet appended to bundle metadata. Also included installer manifest diff:

```
- kube-connector: 0.9.1
+ kube-connector: 0.9.0 # pinned due to GC leak in 0.9.1
```

sasha: One more: add transport lock on artifact publish so we don't have concurrent re-publishes during customer pickup. ops-ci, can deploy-bot enforce a mutex on registry publish?

ops-ci: Deploy-bot will check for publish-lock key in redis before pushing. If lock present it will wait up to 10m then fail. I'll add a check to the job.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed (signatures ok, checksums match). Proceeding to upload to offsite bucket in 10s.

alex: :white_check_mark: Uploading now. I will post final checksum and RCA-ready notes once complete.

deploy-bot: upload complete. offsite://private-vpc/1.4.0-rc2/private-vpc-1.4.0-rc2.tar.gz sha256=3f7a9c4b2d1e8f5c6a9b0d2c4e7f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8

maya: Thanks — I'll prep the canary customers list and the short release note for the account team.

alex: Great. Final checklist: 1) manifest pinned, 2) signed artifact uploaded, 3) publish lock enforced, 4) canary window scheduled, 5) rollback criteria in deploy job. If no objections, we'll start canary at 23:05 UTC.

ben: No objections from my side. Marking release docs draft as ready for review.

ops-ci: Canary start scheduled for 23:05 UTC. Manual approval required to expand to full rollout.

alex: Closing thread — will post a follow-up with post-canary metrics and any rollback actions.

deploy-bot: NOTE: If rollback fires, a follow-up task will create incident ticket and tag @oncall.
